title: Provider
description: Choose the transcription service and access key. Changes are saved automatically.
active.label: Active provider
egress.tooltip.external: Your audio is sent to this provider's cloud to be transcribed.
egress.tooltip.local: Your audio is processed on your machine/network — nothing goes out to the internet.
embedded.note: This is a local (offline) model. Downloading, activating, and removing it are done on the <1>Models</1> tab.
language.label: Language
language.hint: Leave it on automatic to let the provider detect the spoken language.
endpoint.hint.external: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. For well-known providers, you don't need to change it.
endpoint.hint.local: URL of your OpenAI-compatible local server (whisper.cpp, LM Studio, Speaches…).
apiKey.hint.external: Paste the provider's key. It's stored only on your machine.
apiKey.hint.local: Local servers usually don't require a key — leave it blank if yours doesn't ask for one.
model.label: Model
model.listFailed: Couldn't list the models — type the model name by hand (local servers may not offer this list).
manage.title: Manage providers
manage.description: Add a well-known service, duplicate the current one, or remove one you don't use.
manage.add.label: Add a provider
manage.add.hint: Choose a well-known service — it comes with the address and model already filled in; you just paste the key.
manage.rename.label: Active provider name
manage.remove.disabledTooltip: You must keep at least one provider.
dialog.remove.title: Remove this provider?
dialog.remove.description: “{{label}}” will be removed from your list. Wren will switch to another configured provider. You can add it again later.
